specs.title: two tabs retain independent drafts through conflicts, reload, explicit discard and deletion recovery
edits and reset during an update waiting for the lock are retained while only the captured snapshot is committed
changed, missing, unavailable and expired offers retain amounts and can still be updated
local links are device-bound; malformed or missing IDs do not request offers
capacity blocks Duplicate without blocking Update; source profiles, events and legacy-copy work survive opening
unavailable locks and draft storage keep reading and independent sharing available
